verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers internal links (obsidian-docs-18, obsidian-docs-36) and hover previews (obsidian-docs-39), but contains no mention of block/section-level embedding or transclusion syntax (e.g. ![[note#heading]] or block references) that would let a power-user embed and keep in sync a specific block from another note. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or community confirmation of block/section transclusion and its live-sync behavior.
